sources.evidence: Live homepage of the BUBT-hosted 'ICPC Asia Dhaka Regional Contest 2025' (registration countdown, Dec 2025 dates); /1997 serves the current edition, not 1997.
Small page headed 'Asia Regional/Dhaka' with 5 ranked teams (Rank, University, Problem Solved, Time Used) followed by 13 unranked 'Honorable Participants'.

notes: The page does not state a year; the 1997 attribution rests on the file name Dhaka97rank.html and the problem names in the pack. Pack has no date or location; none is given in the documents. Page is hosted on a swt.edu personal page (probably a coach's).
